newsitem.title: DENMARK: Danish shares edge up at start, more gains ahead.
newsitem.headline: Danish shares edge up at start, more gains ahead.

text.p: Danish share prices opened slightly higher on Friday in a market with positive undertone after the Constitution Day holiday, with dealers seeing more solid gains up front.
"We rose handsomely on Wednesday, the positive mood today could mean KFX index rises of between a quarter and a half point," one dealer said.
He said focus was expected to be on major banks and Tele Danmark, which finished 14 crowns up at 335 on Wednesday on rumours that BT Telecom was to take a stake in it.
The KFX top-20 index gained 0.19 point to 167.64 at 0720 GMT, having closed 1.51 point up on Wednesday.
